rituals.recognition_cue: Test: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Imagine Trays → Sort Facts → Balance Verdict
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Imagine Trays → Sort Facts → Balance Verdict
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays. Two Tray — hear sound.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence. Two Tray — notice detail.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same. Two Tray — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Balance Verdict.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Balance Verdict clicked.

MY RESULT
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.my_result: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Try: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Fear → Add Likely → Act Now
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line. Worst Case — feel support.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely. Worst Case — add counterfact.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now. Worst Case — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act Now.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Act Now held.

MY RESULT
My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.

rituals.hook: Watch: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Score Odds → Weigh Evidence → Follow Evidence
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Watch: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Score Odds → Weigh Evidence → Follow Evidence
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Score Odds — Give the prediction a number from 0 to 100. Odds Receipt — press feet.
2. Check Baseline — Find one relevant base rate: how often has this happened in similar situations?
3. Weigh Evidence — Notice one fact that raises the odds and another that lowers them. Odds Receipt — camera check.
4. Revise Odds — Issue a revised number and date it.
5. Follow Evidence — Act from the revision, not the original alarm. Odds Receipt — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Follow Evidence.

WIN SIGNAL
Follow Evidence cleared.

MY RESULT
Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Catch: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine A Pie — Imagine a pie that stands for everything that caused the situation. Blame Pie — breathe naturally.
2. Share The Slices — In your mind, give slices to your choices, other people, circumstances, systems, timing, and chance.
3. Check The Whole — Make sure all slices together equal 100. Blame Pie — split duty.
4. Find Your Slice — Focus only on your true share.
5. Choose Repair — Picture one repair for your slice. Let the rest stay outside your responsibility. Blame Pie — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Repair.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Choose Repair shifted.

MY RESULT
I found my slice. I don't own the whole pie.
rituals.my_result: I found my slice. I don't own the whole pie.
rituals.formula_flow: Imagine A Pie → Share The Slices → Check The Whole → Find Your Slice → Choose Repair
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Set it down if sharing turns into punishment or erases genuine accountability.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:

Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Imagine Trusted → Remove Name → Apply Page
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Trusted — Imagine a trusted person bringing you the same facts. Borrow Their — loosen hands.
2. Offer Allowances — Hold the questions you would ask them, the allowances you would make, and the evidence you would require before judging them.
3. Remove Name — Now remove their name. Borrow Their — allow opposite.
4. Apply Page — Apply that page to yourself without adding a harsher clause. Borrow Their — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Apply Page.

3. Continue Stable — Continue only until one stable rule repeats. Rule Under — pick action.
4. Box Rule — Box Rule Rule that rule.
5. Today — Today’s task is to inspect it, not obey it. Rule Under — next action.

TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Spot: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Close Door → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Close Door — Picture the two leading options. Cross out one for thirty seconds and pretend it is unavailable; do not commit. Close Door — hear sound.
2. Read Protest — Notice the first specific reaction—relief, disappointment, bargaining, urgency, or no change. Name it in four words or fewer.
3. Reopen Choice — Uncross the option. Repeat once with the other door closed so both reactions receive the same test. Close Door — pick action.
4. Choose Next — Use the clearer reaction as one piece of data, then choose only the next responsible move. Close Door — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Next.

WIN SIGNAL
Choose Next cleared.

MY RESULT
I just found a next choice without solving my whole future.

rituals.title: ONE VISIBLE VOTE
rituals.name: ONE VISIBLE VOTE
rituals.hook: Pause: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.recognition_cue: Pause: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.goal: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.mission: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.challenge: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.immediate_need: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Value → Complete Shift → Tiny
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Choose Value → Complete Shift → Tiny
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Pause: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Values become real only after the body votes.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Choose Value → Complete Shift → Tiny
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Value — Choose a value and design its smallest public evidence: send the honest line, open the document, place the medicine beside water, step outside for two minutes. Visible Vote — press feet.
2. Complete Shift — Complete it before upgrading the plan. Visible Vote — allow opposite.
3. Tiny — A tiny enacted vote outranks a perfect private speech. Visible Vote — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Tiny.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Tiny closed.

MY RESULT
Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.my_result: Values become real only after the body votes.
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Value → Complete Shift → Tiny

rituals.hook: Aim: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
rituals.recognition_cue: Aim: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
rituals.goal: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.

rituals.challenge: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
rituals.immediate_need: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Use Control → Focus On Costs → Choose Experiment
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Use Control → Focus On Costs → Choose Experiment
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Aim: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Use Control → Focus On Costs → Choose Experiment
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Use Control — Name everything used to control the feeling: checking, avoiding, numbing, arguing, reassurance, overworking. Control Graveyard — breathe naturally.
2. Picture Short — Beside each, Picture the short-term payoff and the six-month bill.
3. Focus On Costs — Focus on any method whose bill exceeds its relief. Control Graveyard — allow opposite.
4. Choose Experiment — Choose one experiment in not paying that cost today. Control Graveyard — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Experiment.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Choose Experiment worked.

MY RESULT
Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
rituals.my_result: Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.

rituals.ritual_name: THE SKY DOES NOT BECOME THE WEATHER
rituals.hook: Probe: Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Thought → Rest Openness → Return Feeling
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Thought → Rest Openness → Return Feeling
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Probe: Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Thought → Rest Openness → Return Feeling
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Thought — Name one thought, one feeling, and one role active now. Sky Does — move slowly.
2. Say Being — For each, say: ‘This is being noticed.’ Search for the noticing itself—its colour, age, or mood.
3. Rest Openness — If none can be found, rest with that openness for ten seconds. Sky Does — split duty.
4. Return Feeling — Return by feeling both feet. Sky Does — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return Feeling.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Return Feeling settled.

MY RESULT
Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.
rituals.my_result: Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Thought → Say Being → Rest Openness → Return Feeling
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid prolonged self-inquiry if it intensifies feeling unreal or detached from yourself or unreality.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Shift: Goodwill can interrupt hostility without pretending closeness.
rituals.recognition_cue: Shift: Goodwill can interrupt hostility without pretending closeness.
rituals.goal: Goodwill can interrupt hostility without pretending closeness.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Bring Person → State Boundary → Keep Discernment
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Bring Person → State Boundary → Keep Discernment
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Shift: Goodwill can interrupt hostility without pretending closeness.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Goodwill can interrupt hostility without pretending closeness.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Bring Person → State Boundary → Keep Discernment
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Bring Person — Bring the person to mind at a safe distance. Clean Wish — widen gaze.
2. Keep It Honest — Choose one honest wish that does not deny harm: ‘May we both be free from causing more suffering,’ or ‘May safety become possible.’ Offer it once.
3. State Boundary — Then state the boundary or action you still need. Clean Wish — split duty.
4. Keep Discernment — Warmth does not cancel discernment. Clean Wish — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Discernment.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Keep Discernment settled.

MY RESULT
Goodwill can interrupt hostility without pretending closeness.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Set Code → Reverse Code → Claim Control
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Set Code → Reverse Code → Claim Control
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Look: A short body code can prove that alarm has not taken every control.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A short body code can prove that alarm has not taken every control.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Set Code → Reverse Code → Claim Control
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Set Code — Choose three tiny comfortable movements, such as tap a knee, touch a thumb, and look at one fixed object. Say the order once. Play Body — hear sound.
2. Run Order — Perform A–B–C slowly, pausing after each movement long enough to feel it finish.
3. Reverse Code — Perform C–B–A at the same pace. If you lose the order, return to neutral and restart instead of speeding up. Play Body — name sensation.
4. Claim Control — Name the movement you directed most clearly, then let the whole code stop. Play Body — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Claim Control.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Claim Control locked.

MY RESULT
A short body code can prove that alarm has not taken every control.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Breathe Pulling — Breathe in without pulling extra air. Longer Out — move slowly.

3. Match Posture — Match posture, words, and behaviour until the new signal is coherent. Reverse Urge — next action.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Identify Protective → Drop Legitimate → Observe Outcome
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Aim: Safety behaviours can hide the safety you are trying to learn.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Safety behaviours can hide the safety you are trying to learn.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Identify Protective → Drop Legitimate → Observe Outcome
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Protective — During a manageable exposure, spot one protective act that is unnecessary: gripping, rehearsing, sitting by the exit, checking pulse, carrying reassurance. Remove Invisible — breathe naturally.
2. Drop Legitimate — Drop only that act while keeping legitimate safety intact. Remove Invisible — pick action.
3. Observe Outcome — Observe what the outcome says without it. Remove Invisible — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Outcome.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Observe Outcome worked.

MY RESULT
I made the avoided thing a little smaller by meeting it.
rituals.my_result: I made the avoided thing a little smaller by meeting it.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Repeat Mastered → Keep Small → Turn Local
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Repeat Mastered — Repeat a mastered practice while changing one feature: location, time, cue order, duration, or intensity. Move Lesson — move slowly.
2. Round — On the next round, alter a different feature.
3. Keep Small — Keep a small Keep of where the skill still works. Move Lesson — find evidence.
4. Turn Local — Variation turns a local exception into portable knowledge. Move Lesson — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Turn Local.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Select Triggers → Drop Unnecessary → Stay Long
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Select Triggers — Select two triggers already tolerable separately. Two Cue — loosen hands.
2. Predict Joining — Predict what joining them will add.
3. Drop Unnecessary — Contact both at a modest dose while dropping unnecessary escape. Two Cue — notice detail.
4. Stay Long — Stay long enough to compare the combined result with the forecast, then recover fully. Two Cue — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Stay Long.

PLAY: Smallest → Ask Whether → Let Determine
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Smallest — Notice the smallest spontaneous tendency: sway, curl, stretch, turn, reach. Turn Up — soften shoulders.

4. Let Determine — Let the answer determine whether to continue, reverse, or stop. Turn Up — next action.

4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty. Stamp Where — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Core.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove the manager from respiration.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Follow Breaths → Start → Witness Motion
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Follow Breaths — Follow three natural breaths exactly as they occur. Let Breath — breathe naturally.
2. Leave Breath Alone — Do not deepen, slow, count, or improve them.
3. Start — Notice where each begins by itself and where it ends without instruction. Let Breath — notice detail.
4. Let Body — Between breaths, let the body choose again.
5. Witness Motion — Your only action is witnessing what already knows how to move. Let Breath — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Witness Motion.

rituals.trigger_play_time:

Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Observe Ordinary → Phase → Check Whether
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Observe Ordinary — Observe three ordinary cycles. Find Busy — move slowly.
2. Rate Inhale — Rate inhale effort and exhale release separately.
3. Phase — Which phase is working too hard?. Find Busy — find evidence.
4. Leave Timing — Ease only that side toward neutral—less pulling in or less pushing out—while leaving timing alone.
5. Check Whether — Check if urgency changes when imbalance decreases. Find Busy — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Whether.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Choose Slow → Use Quiet → Continue Long
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Slow — Choose a slow, comfortable pace in which inhale and exhale feel smooth. Rhythm Before — loosen hands.
2. Use Quiet — Use a quiet timer or gentle movement as metronome, never forcing lung volume. Rhythm Before — name sensation.
3. Continue Long — Continue long enough to find a repeatable rhythm, then remove the metronome and keep one easy cycle. Rhythm Before — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Continue Long.

PLAY: Pick Requires → Imagine Pair → Complete Few
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Requires — Pick a count that requires no effort. Even Bridge — widen gaze.

4. Complete Few — Complete a few balanced crossings, then let counting dissolve. Even Bridge — next action.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Sit Easy — Sit Easy Easy comfortably. Alternate Airway — soften shoulders.

3. Continue Unhurried — Continue alternating with an unhurried hand. Alternate Airway — notice detail.
4. Keep Breath — Keep the breath quiet and abandon retention.

Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Take Ordinary → Stop Empty → Listen Silence
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Take Ordinary — Take an ordinary inhale. Vibration Way — hear sound.
2. Leave Feeling — Hum at a soft, comfortable pitch as air leaves, feeling vibration in lips, face, or chest.
3. Stop Empty — Stop before empty. Vibration Way — name sensation.
4. Listen Silence — Listen to the silence after the hum, then decide whether another round would still feel kind. Vibration Way — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Listen Silence.

Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.

1. Take Ordinary — Take an ordinary inhale. Vibration Way — hear sound.
2. Leave Feeling — Hum at a soft, comfortable pitch as air leaves, feeling vibration in lips, face, or chest.
3. Stop Empty — Stop before empty. Vibration Way — name sensation.
4. Listen Silence — Listen to the silence after the hum, then decide whether another round would still feel kind. Vibration Way — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Listen Silence.
rituals.win_reward_source:
🏆 WIN
Listen Silence closed.

MY RESULT
I can let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.

rituals.name: EXHALE IN CHAPTERS
rituals.hook: Notice: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.recognition_cue: Notice: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.goal: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.mission: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.challenge: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.immediate_need: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Let Air → Keep Face → Wait Body
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Let Air → Keep Face → Wait Body
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Notice: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A large release can become several manageable ones.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Let Air → Keep Face → Wait Body
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Let Air — Instead of one continuous out-breath, let air leave in three soft portions with tiny unforced spaces between. Exhale Chapters — breathe naturally.
2. Keep Face — Keep the face loose and never push to empty. Exhale Chapters — name sensation.
3. Wait Body — After the final segment, wait for the body’s next inhale rather than grabbing it. Exhale Chapters — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Wait Body.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Wait Body registered.

MY RESULT
A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.my_result: A large release can become several manageable ones.
rituals.formula_flow: Let Air → Keep Face → Wait Body

Resume normal breathing if segmentation causes urgency or tingling.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Slow — Take one slow movement with two directions—arms open and close, rise and lower, reach and return. Breathe Gesture — move slowly.

3. Let Movement — Let movement size follow comfort, then complete one cycle without conscious pairing. Breathe Gesture — next action.

rituals.name: CATCH WANTING BEFORE THE OBJECT
rituals.hook: Flip: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.recognition_cue: Flip: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.goal: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.mission: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.challenge: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.immediate_need: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Wait Pull → Observe Wanting → Name Object
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Wait Pull → Observe Wanting → Name Object
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Flip: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Desire starts moving before it names a destination.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Wait Pull → Observe Wanting → Name Object
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Wait Pull — Wait at the first pull: leaning, brightening, reaching, mental zoom. Catch Wanting — move slowly.
2. Observe Wanting — For five seconds, observe wanting as raw movement without completing ‘I want…’. Catch Wanting — notice detail.
3. Name Object — Only afterward name the object and decide whether pursuit serves the wider situation. Catch Wanting — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Name Object.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Name Object closed.

MY RESULT
Desire starts moving before it names a destination.
rituals.my_result: Desire starts moving before it names a destination.

GOAL
Release both hands of mental grasping.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Check The Pull → Let Content → Act According
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Check The Pull — Notice whether experience is being pulled closer or pushed away. Against Still — press feet.
2. Relax — Relax the corresponding inner movement without demanding neutrality.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Stabilise → Attend Object → Rest Briefly
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Stabilise — Stabilise attention on one simple form. Erase Object — loosen hands.
2. Remove Name — Gradually remove its name, meaning, shape, and boundary in that order.
3. Attend Object — Preserve the ongoing sense of attending as the object loses definition. Erase Object — split duty.
4. Rest Briefly — Rest briefly with contact that no longer depends on a clear thing. Erase Object — next action.

Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Twist: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove identities without attacking experience.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Body → Keep Perspective → Rest Unlabelled
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Body — Notice body, sensation, thought, emotion, and role in turn. Still Here — breathe naturally.
2. Keep Perspective — For each say, ‘Observed—therefore not the whole observer.’ Do not claim they are unreal. Still Here — name sensation.
3. Rest Unlabelled — After the sequence, rest with what remains unlabelled, then reconnect to name and place. Still Here — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Rest Unlabelled.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Pair → Swap Variable → Tag Driver
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Pair — Name two emotions in the mixture and rate each with a simple low, medium, or high—not a number. Change Thing — widen gaze.
2. Hold Scene — Hold the scene steady. Choose only one variable to test: person, time, place, audience, or outcome.
3. Swap Variable — Imagine that one variable changed for ten seconds. Keep every other fact the same. Change Thing — name feeling.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Zoom: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Word — Choose one harmless five-letter word, such as TABLE. Use each letter once; there is no need to finish perfectly. Break Night — feel support.
2. Call Object — For the first letter, name a neutral object beginning with it—T for tree, for example.
3. Flash Image — Picture that object for about two seconds with no action, meaning, memory, or story. Break Night — allow opposite.
4. Jump Letter — Jump to the next letter and a completely unrelated object. End after five letters; do not score sleep. Break Night — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Jump Letter.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Jump Letter worked.

MY RESULT
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
rituals.my_result: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
rituals.formula_flow: Pick Word → Call Object → Flash Image → Jump Letter
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Use only while safely resting; never while driving. Stop if images become distressing, compulsive, or disorienting.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Throwaway → Fix One → Continue Clean
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Imagine: A throwaway mistake can make the first move lose its authority.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A throwaway mistake can make the first move lose its authority.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Throwaway → Fix One → Continue Clean
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Throwaway — Open a private mental sandbox and mark it THROWAWAY—NOT FOR SENDING. Make First — feel support.
2. Make Wrong — Imagine one obviously imperfect start: a clumsy first sentence, rough title, messy mental sketch, or unfinished opening.
3. Fix One — Correct exactly one useful part without polishing the rest. Make First — allow opposite.
4. Continue Clean — Keep working only if the task now feels editable; otherwise keep the corrected fragment in mind and stop cleanly. Make First — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Continue Clean.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Continue Clean shifted.

MY RESULT
A throwaway mistake can make the first move lose its authority.

rituals.formula_flow: Throwaway → Make Wrong → Fix One → Continue Clean

rituals.play_the_loop:

2. Check Protection — Does it protect something real?
3. Leave Me — Does it leave me more capable afterward?. Ally Saboteur — pick action.
4. Score Yes — Score each yes or no.
5. Thank Warning — If it fails two, thank the warning and appoint a different inner adviser. Ally Saboteur — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Thank Warning.

rituals.hook: Twist: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.recognition_cue: Twist: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

rituals.immediate_need: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Take Event → Identify Facts → Try Construction
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Take Event → Identify Facts → Try Construction
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Twist: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Take Event → Identify Facts → Try Construction
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Take Event — Take one rigid reading of an event. Waking Dream — soften shoulders.
2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed. Waking Dream — estimate odds.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes. Waking Dream — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Try Construction.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Try Construction landed.

MY RESULT
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.my_result: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.formula_flow: Take Event → Compare Dream → Identify Facts → Try Construction

Avoid dreamlike framing if it increases derealisation or psychotic symptoms.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Test: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Pattern → Compare Conditions → Transplant Edge
rituals.trigger_play_time:

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Pattern → Compare Conditions → Transplant Edge
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Pattern — Name the recurring pattern in one line, including the trigger and usual response. Find Where — hear sound.
2. Find Misses — Find two occasions when the same kind of trigger produced no pattern or a clearly weaker version.
3. Compare Conditions — Compare the exceptions. Spot one shared condition that you can influence: timing, preparation, company, distance, information, or body care. Find Where — notice detail.
4. Transplant Edge — Place that condition into the next comparable situation and define what weaker would look like. Find Where — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Transplant Edge.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Transplant Edge clicked.

MY RESULT
A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.

rituals.trigger_play_time:

PLAY TIME

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some mental worlds persist through continuous subscription.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Identify Image → Let Existing → Redirect
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Image — Spot the image, conclusion, or demand being refreshed. Stop Renewing — feel support.
2. Time — For one minute, refuse only the renewal: no new scene, argument, or confirmation.
3. Let Existing — Let existing residue fade at its own rate. Stop Renewing — name sensation.
4. Redirect — Redirect the freed attention into a chosen sensory task. Stop Renewing — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Redirect.

rituals.trigger_play_time:

HOOK
Catch: Silence often disappears because the mind fills it immediately.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Silence often disappears because the mind fills it immediately.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Wait Thought → Rest Duration → Count Gap
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Wait Thought — Wait for a thought to end naturally. Do Replace — breathe naturally.
2. Empty — At the first empty beat, resist generating commentary about emptiness.
3. Rest Duration — Rest for the duration available—even a fraction. Do Replace — pick action.
4. Let Thought — Let the next thought arise without invitation.
5. Count Gap — Count the gap only after it is over. Do Replace — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Count Gap.

Count Gap shifted.

MY RESULT
Silence often disappears because the mind fills it immediately.

PLAY: Name Cannot → Take Concrete → Let Action
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Cannot — Name what cannot be changed today. Effort Still — move slowly.
2. Name Smallest — Beside it, name the smallest domain where effort remains possible.
3. Take Concrete — Take one concrete step there before returning to contemplation. Effort Still — pick action.
4. Let Action — Let action answer the part of the problem that is actually yours. Effort Still — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Action.

PLAY: Contrasting → Include Shared → Let Difference
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Contrasting — Notice two contrasting experiences—pleasant and painful, self and other, sound and silence. Difference Inside — widen gaze.
2. Hold Distinct — Hold their distinct qualities without merging them.
3. Include Shared — Then include the shared field in which both are present. Difference Inside — notice detail.
4. Let Difference — Let difference remain vivid without translating it into separation. Difference Inside — next action.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Find Smallest → Name Exit → Choose Door
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Find Smallest → Name Exit → Choose Door
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Imagine: When uncertain, buy information without buying a prison.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
When uncertain, buy information without buying a prison.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Find Smallest → Name Exit → Choose Door
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Find Smallest — Find the smallest action that tests the direction and can be undone: trial, prototype, conversation, temporary booking, one-week schedule. Reversible Door — loosen hands.
2. Name Exit — Name the exit cost and the fact the step could reveal. Reversible Door — pick action.
3. Choose Door — Choose the door that returns with data. Reversible Door — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Door.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Choose Door shifted.

MY RESULT
When uncertain, buy information without buying a prison.
rituals.my_result: When uncertain, buy information without buying a prison.
rituals.formula_flow: Find Smallest → Name Exit → Choose Door

PAUSE
Do not treat apparently reversible steps as harmless without checking consequences.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Picture Worry → Decide Accept → Close Time
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Picture Worry → Decide Accept → Close Time
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rumination & worry loops

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Pause: Give concern an appointment so it stops running reception.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give concern an appointment so it stops running reception.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Picture Worry → Decide Accept → Close Time
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture Worry — Picture the worry exactly and schedule a specific review window later today. Worry Has — widen gaze.
2. Add Genuinely — Until then, add only genuinely new facts to the Notice; no live analysis.
3. Decide Accept — At the appointment, decide: act, plan, accept, or discard. Worry Has — notice detail.
4. Close Time — Close on time even if certainty is absent. Worry Has — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Close Time.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Close Time closed.

MY RESULT
I gave the worry a stopping point.
rituals.my_result: I gave the worry a stopping point.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: Relationship care does not require surrendering the point.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Relationship care does not require surrendering the point.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Remove Attacks → Keep Core → Edit Delivery
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Remove Attacks — Remove attacks from your wording. Soft Delivery — move slowly.
2. Validate Understandable — Show one sign of genuine interest, validate the understandable part of the other experience, and use an easy rather than contemptuous manner.
3. Keep Core — Keep your core message unchanged. Soft Delivery — challenge answer.
4. Edit Delivery — Gentleness edits delivery, not truth. Soft Delivery — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Edit Delivery.

MY RESULT
Relationship care does not require surrendering the point.

rituals.hook: Try: A conversation should not corrupt your own values.
rituals.recognition_cue: Try: A conversation should not corrupt your own values.
rituals.goal: A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Respond Verify → Revise Sentence → Speak Extra
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Respond Verify → Revise Sentence → Speak Extra
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Try: A conversation should not corrupt your own values.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Respond Verify → Revise Sentence → Speak Extra
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Respond Verify — Before responding, verify four conditions: fair to both sides; no apology for merely existing or setting a limit; aligned with your values; completely truthful. Self Respect — loosen hands.
2. Revise Sentence — Revise any sentence that fails the checksum. Self Respect — split duty.
3. Speak Extra — Then speak without extra justification. Self Respect — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Speak Extra.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Speak Extra held.

MY RESULT
A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. See The Person — Imagine the person in front of you. Say Mind — loosen hands.
2. Say What Happened — In your mind, say what happened, what you felt, what you needed, and what you now choose to release.
3. Do Not Edit — Let the message be honest, but do not plan harm. Say Mind — notice detail.
4. Wait — Do not contact the person for twenty-four hours. Let the message stay only in your mind. Say Mind — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Wait.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture — Picture having lost access to your current life and unexpectedly waking inside it again. Life Returned — widen gaze.
2. Small — What small feature would suddenly matter—someone’s voice, a body ability, unfinished work, morning light?. Life Returned — notice detail.
3. Choose Behaviour — Choose one behaviour that honours that recovered value today, without romanticising real hardship. Life Returned — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Behaviour.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Language can lower heat without lowering truth.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Underline → Observe Behaviour → Read Action
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Underline — Underline absolutes and inflammatory terms in your account. Cool Words — feel support.
2. Observe Behaviour — Exchange every one for a precise factual equivalent: ‘always’ becomes the actual frequency; ‘destroyed’ becomes the specific loss; ‘evil’ becomes the observed behaviour. Cool Words — name sensation.
3. Read Action — Re-read and notice what action the cooler version supports. Cool Words — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Read Action.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Keep Both Versions — The moment an outcome differs from expectation, Keep both versions verbatim. Capture Model — breathe naturally.
2. State Size — State the size and direction of the error.
3. Name Miss — Finish with: ‘The old model must now explain…’ and name the discrepancy. Capture Model — estimate odds.
4. Preserve Forecast — Do not let hindsight rewrite the original forecast. Capture Model — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Preserve Forecast.

I judged the old choice using what I knew then—not what I know now.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Pin Forecast → Score Odds → Update Odds
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pin Forecast — Restate the fear as one visible or audible forecast—not a vague catastrophe. Make Fear — move slowly.
2. Set Clock — Give the forecast a real time window.
3. Score Odds — Set confidence on a 0–100 scale before checking anything. Make Fear — find evidence.
4. Observe Safely — Use only a naturally occurring safe observation; never manufacture a test.
5. Update Odds — Hold the result and update confidence in either direction. Make Fear — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Update Odds.

TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Test: A warning must become testable before it can command you.

GOAL
A warning must become testable before it can command you.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Pin Forecast → Score Odds → Update Odds

1. Pin Forecast — Restate the fear as one visible or audible forecast—not a vague catastrophe. Make Fear — move slowly.
2. Set Clock — Give the forecast a real time window.
3. Score Odds — Set confidence on a 0–100 scale before checking anything. Make Fear — find evidence.
4. Observe Safely — Use only a naturally occurring safe observation; never manufacture a test.
5. Update Odds — Hold the result and update confidence in either direction. Make Fear — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Update Odds.

WIN SIGNAL
Update Odds clicked.

MY RESULT
A warning must become testable before it can command you.

4. Decide After — Decide only after the braid is complete. Braid Signals — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Decide After.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Scan Work → Bind Object → Run Command
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Scan Work — Look at the task and choose the single action verb needed for the next minute: read, compare, type, sort, call, or check. Run Two — move slowly.
2. Pick Verb — Choose the exact object receiving that action: paragraph, invoice, shelf, patient Name, pan, or message.
3. Bind Object — Join them into a two-word command such as TYPE SUMMARY or SORT RECEIPTS. Hide every other instruction for now. Run Two — notice detail.
4. Run Command — Run the command for sixty to ninety seconds. Stop only when the verb or object genuinely needs to change. Run Two — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Run Command.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Press Equal → Step Down → Reach Zero
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Press Equal → Step Down → Reach Zero
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Flip: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Press Equal → Step Down → Reach Zero
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Press Equal — Press palms together—or both hands into one cushion—at about twenty percent effort. Keep breathing ordinary. Match Pressure — move slowly.
2. Match Force — Adjust until neither side wins and the pressure feels equal. Hold that match for two seconds.
3. Step Down — Lower both sides together through three gentle levels: fifteen, ten, then five percent. Match Pressure — name feeling.
4. Reach Zero — Reach zero, rest both hands on a stable surface, and observe whether the urge to press returns. Match Pressure — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Reach Zero.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Reach Zero closed.

MY RESULT
Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.

rituals.name: DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL
rituals.hook: Shift: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.recognition_cue: Shift: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.goal: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.mission: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Read Channels → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Read Channels → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Shift: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Read Channels → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Read Channels — Read three channels without searching your whole body: SPEED, PRESSURE, and TEMPERATURE. Use lower, medium, or high. Disassemble Alarm — widen gaze.
2. Pick Smallest — Choose the safest channel with the lowest intensity. Do not pick the loudest one.
3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness. Disassemble Alarm — name sensation.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are. Disassemble Alarm — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Panel.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Check Panel settled.

MY RESULT
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.my_result: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.formula_flow: Read Channels → Pick Smallest → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
New, severe, or unusual physical symptoms require medical assessment. Stop for pain, faintness, breathing difficulty, confusion, or loss of orientation.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Cadence → Choose Opposite → Observe Emotional
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Notice: Emotion maintains itself through tempo as well as story.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Emotion maintains itself through tempo as well as story.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Cadence → Choose Opposite → Observe Emotional
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Cadence — Notice the cadence of speech, movement, or breathing. Change Rhythm — soften shoulders.
2. Choose Opposite — Choose an opposite rhythm: agitated becomes deliberate, collapsed becomes lightly brisk, looping becomes irregular. Change Rhythm — notice detail.
3. Observe Emotional — Maintain the new tempo through one simple task and observe the emotional shift. Change Rhythm — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Emotional.

MY RESULT

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Seat Feelings → Clear Board → Choose Survivor
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Seat Feelings — Label up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first. Find Move — hear sound.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty. Find Move — plain wording.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it. Find Move — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Survivor.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Appears → Replace Identity
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Check: Identity claims must show recent action evidence.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Appears → Replace Identity
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Appears — When ‘I’m lazy,’ ‘I’m unlovable,’ or another global Name appears, demand three specific behaviours from the last month that support it and three that complicate it. Global Labels — press feet.
2. Replace Identity — If the evidence is mixed, replace identity with a narrower situational description. Replace Identity next. Global Labels — allow opposite. Global Labels — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Replace Identity.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Replace Identity clicked.

MY RESULT
Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

Imagine: Every identity grants permissions and charges fees.

GOAL
Every identity grants permissions and charges fees.

PLAY: Sort Identity Costs → Fill The Buckets → Find The Price
rituals.play_the_loop:

3. Find The Price — Focus on the highest hidden cost and ask whether the identity still earns its keep. Price Keeping — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Find The Price.

PLAY TIME

HOOK
Aim: Find the choice that survives without witnesses.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find the choice that survives without witnesses.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Imagine Nobody → Choose Direct → Take Smallest
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Nobody — Imagine nobody will see, praise, criticise, repost, or hear about the action. Remove Audience — soften shoulders.
2. Erase Audience — Erase the imagined audience one row at a time.
3. Choose Direct — What would you choose if only direct consequences and values remained?. Remove Audience — split duty.
4. Take Smallest — Take the smallest version privately. Remove Audience — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Take Smallest.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Take Smallest worked.

MY RESULT
I can find the choice that survives without witnesses.

PLAY: Picture Identity → Choose Shift → Uncover Name
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture Identity — Picture the identity Name on a removable Notice and turn it face down. Blank Nameplate — hear sound.
2. Decision — For the next decision, refer only to capacities, needs, facts, and values.
3. Choose Shift — Choose. Blank Nameplate — allow opposite.
4. Uncover Name — Then uncover the Name and compare what it would have predicted. Blank Nameplate — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Uncover Name.

rituals.recognition_cue: Peek: Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.
rituals.goal: Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.

rituals.immediate_need: Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Give Self → Protect Whole → Chair
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Give Self → Protect Whole → Chair
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Peek: Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Give Self → Protect Whole → Chair
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Give Self — Give each self-state a seat. Call Inner — feel support.
2. Sentence — One sentence each: what I need, what I fear, what I propose.
3. Protect Whole — Appoint a chair whose job is to protect the whole system over time. Call Inner — pick action.
4. Chair — The chair may combine, delay, or reject proposals, but must acknowledge every need. Call Inner — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Chair.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Chair registered.

MY RESULT
Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.
rituals.my_result: Conflicting parts need coordination, not forced unanimity.
rituals.formula_flow: Give Self → Sentence → Protect Whole → Chair
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Use professional support if parts feel autonomous, dangerous, or disorganising.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Don't Recall → Simple → End Reclaim
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Don't Recall → Simple → End Reclaim
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Switch: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Don't Recall → Simple → End Reclaim
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Don't Recall — For sixty seconds, do not recall name, history, status, or plans. Exist Minute — press feet.
2. Stay Changing — Stay with changing sound, pressure, light, and movement.
3. Simple — Notice the simple ongoing sense of being present through those changes. Exist Minute — allow opposite.
4. End Reclaim — Reclaim your biography on purpose at the end. Exist Minute — next action.

⚡ FINISH — End Reclaim.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
End Reclaim locked.

MY RESULT
Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
rituals.my_result: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
rituals.formula_flow: Don't Recall → Stay Changing → Simple → End Reclaim

Stop if life-story quiet creates feeling unreal or detached from yourself.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rumination & worry loops

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Notice: The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Headline Event → Route Bill → Act Present
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Headline Event — State the event as one factual headline with no motive and no sensory replay. Ask Memory — breathe naturally.
2. Extract Claim — Finish this sentence once: ‘This memory still seems to demand ___.’ Keep only one claim.
3. Route Bill — Route the claim to BOUNDARY, REPAIR, GRIEF, or IMPOSSIBLE REVERSAL. Do not create a fifth category. Ask Memory — notice detail.
4. Act Present — Choose the matching present response: set protection, request safe repair, make room for grief, or stop billing today for a reversal history cannot provide. Ask Memory — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act Present.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Act Present registered.

MY RESULT
The memory can submit one claim without replaying the entire case.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Pause: Resistance may accept a neighbouring move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Resistance may accept a neighbouring move.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Choose A Side Step → Let It Lead
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose A Side Step — Pick a small action beside the main task: open one file before starting the work, put on walking shoes before deciding to walk, or wash one ingredient before cooking. Through Side — press feet.
2. Let It Lead — Start with that small step and let it naturally lead into the main task. Let It Lead next. Through Side — pick action. Through Side — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let It Lead.
rituals.win_reward:

Let It Lead closed.

MY RESULT
Resistance may accept a neighbouring move.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Task → Remove Feature → Build Smallest
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Task → Remove Feature → Build Smallest
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Aim: Perfection should not be allowed to cancel function.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Perfection should not be allowed to cancel function.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Task → Remove Feature → Build Smallest
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Task — Name the task’s essential purpose. Version Still — breathe naturally.
2. Remove Feature — Remove every feature not required for that purpose. Version Still — allow opposite.
3. Build Smallest — Build the smallest deliverable that still works, submit or finish it, then upgrade only if time and value justify the addition. Version Still — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Build Smallest.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Build Smallest worked.

MY RESULT
Perfection should not be allowed to cancel function.
rituals.my_result: Perfection should not be allowed to cancel function.

PLAY: Name Contact → Lower One → Hold Setting
rituals.play_the_loop:

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Options → Warning → Choose Visible
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Options — Name the two or three live options. For each, Picture the specific way it could fail—not a vague fear. Choose Easiest — breathe naturally.
2. Name Failure — Name the earliest observable sign that failure has begun. It must be visible or clear, not a feeling alone.
3. Warning — State what corrective action would still be available when that sign appears and what cost has already accumulated. Choose Easiest — name feeling.
4. Choose Visible — Choose the option whose reliable warning arrives while correction is still practical. Use this as one decision criterion, not the whole verdict. Choose Easiest — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Visible.

GOAL

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Widen Feet → Keep Change → Observe Shape
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Widen Feet — Widen feet, elbows, chest, or seating position by a small tolerable amount. Take Up — loosen hands.
2. Keep Change — Keep the change below performance or dominance. Take Up — notice detail.
3. Observe Shape — Observe what the expanded shape signals internally and which words become easier to access. Take Up — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Shape.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Scan Objects → Drop Demands → Choose Helper
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Scan Objects — Choose four safe visible objects without moving toward them. Avoid screens if they add strain. Room Has — breathe naturally.
2. Name Jobs — For each object, name only its ordinary job: chair supports, lamp lights, cup holds, door opens.
3. Drop Demands — Say ‘not needed now’ to every function that does not serve the current safe moment. Do not remove or organise anything. Room Has — pick action.
4. Choose Helper — Choose the one object whose real function supports the next action, then use only that function. Room Has — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Helper.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Mask Names — Ask someone—or a shuffled Notice—to rename the leading options A, B and C without showing which is which. Hide Option — soften shoulders.
2. Choose Traits — Choose three relevant traits, such as cost, time, fit, reliability, or learning. Keep safety facts visible.
3. Rank Blind — Compare the symbols on those traits without guessing their identities and Hold the current order. Hide Option — split forecast.
4. Reveal Options — Reveal the names. Keep the blind order or name exactly what Name changed it and why. Hide Option — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Reveal Options.

Reveal Options held.

MY RESULT

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.plain:
GIVE THE THOUGHT A RETURN ADDRESS

TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Switch: Recurring concerns keep roaming when no destination exists.

GOAL
Recurring concerns keep roaming when no destination exists.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Assign Concern → Say Address → Undeliverable

1. Assign Concern — Assign the concern to one place: a named person, calendar slot, document, task Name, or deliberate release. Give Thought — widen gaze.
2. Say Address — Say the address aloud and route the thought there each time it returns. Give Thought — notice detail.
3. Undeliverable — If no address is useful, Notice it undeliverable. Give Thought — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Undeliverable.

WIN SIGNAL
Undeliverable locked.

MY RESULT
Recurring concerns keep roaming when no destination exists.

Assign Concern → Say Address → Undeliverable

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Begin Anyway → Complete Unit → Test Momentum
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Begin Anyway → Complete Unit → Test Momentum
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Twist: Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Begin Anyway → Complete Unit → Test Momentum
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Begin Anyway — State honestly: ‘Motivation may stay absent.’ Begin the earliest physical component anyway—stand, open, carry, type, dial. Move Before — soften shoulders.
2. Complete Unit — Continue only through one contained unit. Move Before — name feeling.
3. Test Momentum — Let action provide data about if further movement is available. Move Before — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Test Momentum.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Test Momentum landed.

MY RESULT
Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.

PLAY: Run Pulse → Read Strain → Set Gear
rituals.play_the_loop:

2. Full Stop — Stop completely for fifteen seconds. Hands off, eyes away, and no planning the next move.
3. Read Strain — Rate actual strain as light, workable, heavy, or stop. Compare it with what you predicted before starting. Find Working — pick action.
4. Set Gear — Choose the next gear—30/15, 60/30, or stop—and complete exactly one more cycle at that ratio. Find Working — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Gear.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Recall Exchange → Shift → Keep Fact
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Recall Exchange — Choose no more than ten seconds of the interaction, beginning before the moment that felt different. Replay Turning — breathe naturally.
2. Halve Speed — Replay it once in imagination at half speed. Keep to observable words, pauses, volume, face, and movement.
3. Shift — Stop at the first change and name it without motive: ‘the pause lengthened,’ ‘the volume rose,’ or ‘the reply shortened.’. Replay Turning — pick action.
4. Keep Fact — Keep that one fact. End the replay before building another explanation. Replay Turning — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Fact.

Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Choose Skill → Demote Voice → Finish Unit
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Skill — Choose one familiar, low-risk task with clear external feedback. Put Commentator — breathe naturally.

TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Observe Moment → Spot Amplifier → Choose Position
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Observe Moment — Observe the same moment from three positions: body-centred, environment-centred, and whole-field. Rotate Observation — move slowly.
2. Spot Amplifier — Keep what each amplifies and hides. Rotate Observation — notice detail.
3. Choose Position — Choose the position best suited to the upcoming task rather than declaring any one neutral. Rotate Observation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Position.

TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Flip: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.

GOAL
Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Observe Moment → Spot Amplifier → Choose Position

1. Observe Moment — Observe the same moment from three positions: body-centred, environment-centred, and whole-field. Rotate Observation — move slowly.
2. Spot Amplifier — Keep what each amplifies and hides. Rotate Observation — notice detail.
3. Choose Position — Choose the position best suited to the upcoming task rather than declaring any one neutral. Rotate Observation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Position.

WIN SIGNAL
Choose Position closed.

MY RESULT
Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.

FORMULA FLOW
Observe Moment → Spot Amplifier → Choose Position

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Name Stack → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Notice: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Stack → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block. Play Emotion — soften shoulders.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Observe what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference. Play Emotion — name feeling.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing. Play Emotion — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Rebuild Stack.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Rebuild Stack registered.

MY RESULT
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.
rituals.my_result: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Stack → Pull One → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Stop if the game causes numbness, feeling unreal or disconnected, suppression, or pressure to erase a valid feeling.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

HOOK
Flip: Identity signalling can distort an otherwise practical decision.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Identity signalling can distort an otherwise practical decision.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Say About → Check Again → Notice Shift
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Say About — Name what each option would supposedly say about you—successful, loyal, brave, weak, ordinary. Remove Choice — hear sound.
2. Cross Out — Strike through those identity messages mentally.
3. Check Again — Re-check only consequences, values, constraints, and evidence. Remove Choice — split duty.
4. Notice Shift — Notice whether the preferred option changes. Remove Choice — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Notice Shift.

Notice Shift closed.

Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name The Belief → Test Inside → Set Its True Place
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name The Belief — Say the belief silently. Give Belief — widen gaze.
2. Imagine Four Limits — Think about when, where, with whom, and under what conditions it may be true.
3. Test Inside — Picture one real case where it fits. Give Belief — split duty.
4. Test Outside — Picture one real case where it does not fit.
5. Set Its True Place — Say a smaller, more accurate version of the belief. Give Belief — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Its True Place.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Set Its True Place locked.

MY RESULT
A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
